warning_model_report.target: New official advisory/warning issuance in (t,t+3h], not physical inundation
warning_model_report.split_method: Frozen calendar seasons; global storm groups; chronological train/validation/test; 72h purge

split_policy.reason: Full calendar warning seasons; replaces hour-quantile validation dominated by winter. Boundaries frozen before fitting candidates and evaluating test predictions. The 2026 period has previously been inspected for event counts, so this is a retrospective holdout, not prospective validation.

level_screening.note: Historical water-level comparison only. This is not an official flood warning, not a validated flood-risk category, and does not demonstrate safety.

regional_rainfall.caveat: Nearby KMA ASOS/AWS point rainfall is regional context only, not verified upstream catchment rainfall. AWS fallback only shares the same station code. Missing hours are never treated as dry.

experimental.limitations: Non-validated heuristic indicators only. No elevated indicators does NOT mean low flood risk or safety; KMA rainfall is a nearby regional proxy.

explanation.method: Observed inputs only; no fitted warning-model contribution available
explanation.forecast_rainfall: Not used for training without archived availability evidence
